decisions.nm: Thammakaset Co. v. Department of Labour Protection and Welfare (14 Myanmar workers)
decisions.pe: Fourteen workers from Myanmar on a chicken farm in Thailand complained of very long hours, low pay and documents kept by the employer. Labour inspectors ordered compensation. The Supreme Court made the farm pay. The employer also sued workers and advocates for defamation.
decisions.pi: Empat belas pekerja dari Myanmar di sebuah peternakan ayam di Thailand mengadukan jam kerja sangat panjang, upah rendah dan dokumen yang ditahan majikan. Pengawas ketenagakerjaan memerintahkan ganti rugi. Mahkamah Agung mewajibkan peternakan membayar. Majikan juga menggugat pekerja dan pendamping dengan tuduhan…

decisions.nm: Public Prosecutor v. Manas Kongpaen and others (southern trafficking camps)
decisions.pe: In 2015 mass graves of migrants were found in camps near the Thai–Malaysian border. A Bangkok court convicted 62 people, including a senior army officer, of trafficking. An appeal court later increased his sentence.
decisions.pi: Pada 2015 ditemukan kuburan massal migran di kamp dekat perbatasan Thailand–Malaysia. Pengadilan di Bangkok memvonis 62 orang, termasuk seorang perwira tinggi tentara, atas perdagangan orang. Pengadilan banding kemudian memperberat hukumannya.

decisions.nm: Natural Fruit Co. v. Andy Hall
decisions.pe: A British researcher reported abuse of Myanmar workers at a Thai fruit factory. The company sued him for defamation and the court convicted him. The case was criticised for discouraging reporting of abuse.
decisions.pi: Seorang peneliti Inggris melaporkan penganiayaan pekerja Myanmar di pabrik buah di Thailand. Perusahaan menggugatnya atas pencemaran nama baik dan pengadilan memvonisnya. Perkara ini dikritik karena membuat orang enggan melaporkan penganiayaan.

decisions.nm: Koh Tao murder case (Zaw Lin and Wai Phyo)
decisions.pe: Death sentences for two Myanmar migrant workers; questions over evidence and interpretation.
decisions.pi: Hukuman mati bagi dua pekerja migran Myanmar; pertanyaan tentang bukti dan penerjemahan.

help.de: Supports migrant workers from Myanmar with legal cases, trained migrant paralegals and radio programs in their languages. Offices in Chiang Mai (first number) and Mae Sot (second).
help.di: Mendukung pekerja migran dari Myanmar dengan pendampingan perkara, paralegal migran terlatih dan siaran radio dalam bahasa mereka. Kantor di Chiang Mai (nomor pertama) dan Mae Sot (nomor kedua).
